Aguilar Amplification browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type volume/amplification amplification DI browse by enclosure pedal Aguilar Tone Hammer Published on June 11, 2009 Aguilar Amplification boost / preamp DI pedal Silver Limited Edition Silver LE Silver Limited Edition Silver LE Silver Limited Edition Silver LE Silver Limited Edition Silver LE NYC Edition NYC Edition Subway Edition Subway Edition Subway Edition Subway Edition v2 v2 Information Aguilar Amplification This preamp/direct box is so strong and powerful it could only be called the "Tone Hammer"! Based on the respected OBP-3 preamp, the Tone Hammer features fully sweepable midrange frequencies in addition to bass and treble controls. With the Tone Hammer's pristine D.I. you are set for the studio or the stage. To give this tone shaping unit the ultimate flexibility we are introducing our proprietary Adaptive Gain Shaping circuitry (AGS). AGS allows the player to kick in an additional gain structure and EQ with the "stomp" of a button. You can now go from modern slap sounds to vintage or overdriven. 18 volt operation gives the Tone Hammer plenty of headroom to reproduce the most dynamic playing style. Separate "Gain" and "Master" controls allow you to dial in just the right gain structure for any instrument. The Tone Hammer is the essential preamp/direct box for every bassist's tool box.
